hookups.source: https://woodedacrescampground.com/camping.html ('30/50amp Full Hookup, Pull through ... These sites have sewer, water and electric hookups'; 'Premium 30/50amp Full Hookup, Back in'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Back-in electric-only sites on the outer edges (10 with 30-amp, 4 with 30/50-amp), water/electric and full-hookup back-ins, and 30/50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs. Campspot's longest RV site is 45 ft (premium pull-through); the plain water + 30-amp sites run to 34 ft. Seasonal sites are 30-amp only or 30-amp with water.

sites.source: https://woodedacrescampground.com/camping.html ('10 of these sites have 30amp electric and 4 have 30/50amp electric'; 'Premium 30/50amp Full Hookup, Pull through'; 'Seasonal Campsites 30amp Only & 30amp with Water') + Campspot site types (max length 45 ft on 'Premium (Large) Pull Through Full Hookup 30/50 Amp', 34 ft on 'Water + 30 Amp'), read 2026-10-13/2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Campspot) or call. 'Holiday Weekends require a 3-Night Stay and are nonrefundable. All weekends between Memorial Day and Labor Day require a 2-Night stay.' Monthly stays after Labor Day by phone. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am (rules page says noon).
